title: Business Development Executive
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Exciting opportunity to expand business reach, engage with potential clients, and contribute to revenue growth through smart sales strategies and networking. A growth\-oriented role focused on identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with clients, and driving revenue growth. The Business Development Executive will work closely with the sales team to promote services, generate leads, and achieve business targets through strategic communication and market outreach.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through research, networking, and outreach.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Conduct sales calls, meetings, and presentations to promote products and services.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement effective sales strategies.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to revenue growth.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of leads and business prospects.
* Negotiate and close deals with clients effectively.


**Requirements**
* MBA or degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* 0 to 1 year minimum experience
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of sales principles and client handling techniques.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office tools.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-driven environment.

title: Sales & Administration Executive Trainee
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Support business growth by coordinating sales activities, managing administrative operations, and ensuring smooth communication between customers and internal teams. The Sales \& Administration Executive role is designed to provide practical exposure to sales coordination, customer relationship management, and office administration processes. Responsibilities include assisting with customer inquiries, preparing sales documentation, maintaining records, and supporting daily business operations. This position requires strong organizational skills, effective communication, and attention to detail to ensure efficient workflow and customer satisfaction in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist the sales team in generating leads, preparing quotations, and following up with customers.
* Maintain and update customer records, sales reports, and business documentation.
* Handle customer inquiries and provide timely support to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and communication between clients and internal teams.
* Prepare invoices, purchase orders, contracts, and other administrative documents.
* Monitor sales activities and provide regular reports on progress and performance.
* Support marketing and promotional activities as required.
* Manage office administration tasks, including filing, correspondence, and record keeping.
* Ensure accurate data entry and maintain organized databases and documentation.
* Collaborate with different departments to support smooth business operations.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field
* Freshers are encouraged to apply
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills
* Good organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities
* Attention to detail with a willingness to learn and adapt to new processes
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to coordinate administrative and sales activities effectively
* Professional attitude with the ability to maintain confidentiality and work collaboratively in a team environment

title: Sales Manager - Aromatic Chemicals for South India
description:
Sales Manager \- Aromatic Chemicals (South India)
   

  

 Company Profile
   

  

 A leading supplier of fragrance and flavour ingredients in India with over 40 years of domain expertise. The group also manufactures fragrances and aromatic chemicals. The founders are respected for their integrity, business acumen, and strong ability to connect suppliers with consumers across India.
   

  

 Location \& Salary
   

  

 Job location: Anywhere in South India (Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala)
   

  

 Salary: CTC Rs. 8\.0 to 12\.0 LPA plus perks
   

  

**Overview**
* Designation: Sales Manager \- Aroma Ingredients
* Qualification: B.Sc. in Chemistry (preferred)
* Relevant industry: Aromatic chemicals, fragrance \& flavour ingredients, essential oils
* Experience: Minimum 3 years in the aromatic chemicals industry


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage the full sales cycle in the assigned geography: lead generation, handling enquiries, preparing quotations, order confirmation, execution and after\-sales service.
* Proactively plan sales activities to achieve targets, including preparing a daily office itinerary and a weekly client visit schedule.
* Coordinate sampling and follow\-up for new product development or customer\-specific briefs until customer approval is obtained.
* Forecast demand for existing and approved products, coordinate with production for planning, and ensure timely dispatch of finished goods.
* Maintain strong customer relationships to secure repeat business and align deliveries with client requirements.
* Collaborate with agents and distributors to pursue bulk orders, gather market intelligence and support competitive pricing decisions.
* Organise regular business tours and client visits (typical cycles every 15 days) for order follow\-up, sample approvals and forecast confirmation.
* Handle customer complaints promptly, investigate root causes and ensure effective, documented resolution.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction, streamline processes and improve service delivery.
* Maintain accurate sales documentation and timely communication with internal teams to ensure smooth order processing.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Chemistry or a related science.
* Excellent olfactory skills (candidates will be required to complete an internal smelling test).
* Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to interact effectively across all organizational levels.
* Solid project management skills; disciplined and process\-oriented.
* Creative thinker with practical, implementable ideas.
* Good understanding of product functionality, technical capabilities, consumer needs and different market segments.
* Ability to motivate, develop and mentor others.
* Strong execution focus combined with strategic thinking ability.
* Embraces diversity and works well in cross\-functional teams.

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 New Lights LLP delivers premium lighting solutions that blend style, quality, and innovation for residential and commercial spaces. The company offers a wide range of modern decorative and architectural lighting designed to enhance interiors and exteriors. Serving customers across Kerala, New Lights LLP partners with trusted brands such as ACE Gen Next Lighting to ensure reliable and high\-performing products. Team members contribute to creating brighter, more engaging environments for homes and businesses while supporting a growing, design\-focused organization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Customer Relationship Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam. This role focuses on managing customer interactions, responding to inquiries, and providing product information and recommendations for lighting solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include handling walk\-in and existing clients, maintaining records of customer communication, coordinating with the sales and operations teams, and following up on orders and deliveries. The executive will also support after\-sales service, gather customer feedback, and help resolve issues to ensure positive long\-term relationships. The role requires consistent on\-site presence to collaborate with colleagues and engage directly with customers.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to handle inquiries, feedback, and issue resolution professionally.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication with customers and internal teams.
* Basic sales and negotiation abilities, with an interest in promoting lighting solutions and supporting revenue growth.
* Organizational and time\-management skills, including maintaining accurate records and managing multiple customer requests.
* Comfort with using computers and business tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or sales tracking software).
* Ability to work on\-site in Ernakulam and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Prior experience in customer\-facing roles; experience in lighting, retail, or home improvement sectors is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: higher secondary or a diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.

* Knowledge of software development methodologies and technologies.
* Female candidates below 35 years preferred.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Ready to take the next step in your career?
 



 Join our growing team at PayFX and be part of an innovative, fast\-paced work environment where your contributions truly matter.
 



 Company: PayFX Fintech Solutions Private Limited
 



 Role: Business Development Manager
 



 Location: Kerala
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 PayFX is seeking a dynamic and results\-driven Business Development Manager to drive business growth and expand our operations in Kerala. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales, managing key partnerships, ensuring operational excellence, and leading a high\-performing team to achieve business objectives.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Business Growth \& Sales Leadership
 


* Identify and onboard new clients, merchants, and partners to expand PayFX's market presence.
* Drive the adoption of PayFX's payment solutions among businesses in Kerala.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to refine business strategies.



 2\. Key Account \& Relationship Management
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with enterprise clients, channel partners, banks, fintech partners, and distributors.
* Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through exceptional service delivery.
* Resolve escalated customer issues and ensure smooth business operations.



 3\. Operational Excellence \& Compliance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory guidelines, and risk management protocols.
* Oversee regional operations and support functions to ensure seamless execution.
* Analyze sales data, prepare reports, and provide actionable insights to senior management.



 Required Skills
 


* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets, preferably in the Kerala market.
* Strong leadership, team management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical abilities.



 Why Join PayFX?
 


* Opportunity to lead and grow with a fast\-growing fintech company.
* Competitive salary, performance\-based incentives, and excellent career growth opportunities.
* Work with a passionate team driving innovation in digital payments.
* Share your resume at: hr@payfx.co.in
